newsitem.title: USA: IDM wins $21 mln contract for dam project.
newsitem.headline: IDM wins $21 mln contract for dam project.

text.p: IDM Environmental Corp said Tuesday it and its joint venture partner, Sudhakar Engineering, were contracted to perform drilling and grouting on California's East Dam Reservoir project.
The value of the contract is about $21 million, the company said.
The company said it expects to book a portion of this contract in its fourth quarter financial results.
"This project should have a material impact on our 1997 sales and earnings," said Frank Falco, IDM's board chairman.
Work by the joint venture is slated to begin in early December, with completion expected by March 1998, IDM said.
